page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text: signature "h 3" at centre-left and catchword at right.

main_text.p: ciorum splendore civitatem maximè auxit. Semel passa seditionem civilem valdè cruentam Olympiadis xcvi anno tertio, qui fuit xii post captas à Lysandro Athenas, & proximus post illustrem victoriam Cononis ducit Attici ad Cnidum: quam seditionem prolixè describit Xenophon lib. iiii ἐλληνικῶν[?].[illegible, ~6 letters]

Libertas pressa à Macedonibus praesidio monti, qui urbi imminet, quem Acrocorinthum vocant, imposito. Erepta deinde iis ab Arato Sicyonio ac societati Achæorum addita, sed non multo post occupata à Cleomene Lacedæmonio Achæorum hoste, & hoc victo recepta ab Antigono Macedone, à Macedonum jugo cùm aliis non paucis urbibus Græciæ rursum pressa: quo ad debellato à Romanis Philippo rege, duce T. Quintio Flaminio, per conditiones pacis Achæis reddita fuit, & simul totá Græcia jugo Macedonico liberata. Post Corinthus fortuna secunda luxuriâ[illegible, ~8 letters] funditus demum ab iisdem Romanis bello Achaico deleta duce L. Mummio,[illegible, ~5 letters] eodem anno, quo duce P. Scipione Carthago quoque in Africa excisa est. Is fuit annus tertius Olympiadis clviii urbis Romæ secundum Varronem dcviii. Viri omnes in urbe captâ trucidati, fœminæ cum pueris sub coronâ[illegible, ~7 letters]

page.notes: Right margin notes are very small and blurred; only fragments are legible, so they are marked illegible with approximate letter counts. Note placement is approximate. Greek word after "lib. iiii" is uncertain (marked [?]). Left margin shows only show-through and edge marks, which were omitted. Accents on "impositò" and the Roman numerals in lowercase ("clviii", "dcviii") are as far as the scan allows. The phrase "Olympiadis xcvi" is printed lowercase.
